PROP-9ffb0e64-inv-005.text: copy_trie must produce a shallow copy of _data so mutations to copy do not affect original trie.
PROP-9ffb0e64-inv-005.assertion: forall trie t: copy = copy_trie(t) => (copy._data is not t._data) && (forall k: copy._data[k] is t._data[k])

locations.note: Patricia tree class; search for copy/clone methods that perform shallow copy of trie data
